# A13-S42: Control

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

The engagement is super cool :-) My hope is also that The
Synthetic Party will one day grow completely out of my hands. Right now
I still feel a great responsibility to be absolutely sure that it
continues to be a good story. It is a wild and unpredictable
experiment, but surely we can continue to “bring it home” with only
positive attention!

Really good idea with Lorry. I have also thought about TV, but I don't have a television myself, so my knowledge of it is a bit outdated. I will call them tomorrow morning!



Good evening and see you soon :-) best regards [████]
